== Lineage rewrite (2026-10-23) ==
=== Possibly faulty data ===
* Bill's 10 May 2026 slides date the move of SWCCG GEMP onto Players Committee servers as September 2020, with gemp.starwarsccg.org as the new site. Wayback has a 21 January 2019 capture of [https://gemp.starwarsccg.org/gemp-swccg/ gemp.starwarsccg.org/gemp-swccg/] titled Gemp-Swccg. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20190121224944/https://gemp.starwarsccg.org/gemp-swccg/ Internet Archive]. The article uses the 1 September 2020 open-source announcement (forum t=76260) and the June 2018 management change, and leaves the first PC host date unstated.
=== Marginal cuts ===
* OverPower (2014) and Star Trek CCG 2E (2022) GEMP GitHub shells with no working table.
* First git commit date 29 August 2011 (GitHub HTML save returned 520).
* DonKing 2013 LOTR GEMP video and Bi Wisdom 2015 SWCCG GEMP video.
* gempukku.com troll login art (LOTR-only).

* [[Marcin Sciesinski]] is GitHub MarcinSc / forums MarcinS. Different person from [[Marcin Solonczak]].
* play.swccg.com descends from a copy of the Players Committee GEMP: [[Bill Bisco]], 23 October 2026, with the independent-server README on billbisco/swccg-gemp.
